plan.goal: Seed primary human hepatocytes onto the culture area of a 400 µm wide, 20 mm long channel and determine cells to seed per channel.
plan.rationale: PHH are primary cells that do not divide in vitro, so they are seeded at final working density (100,000–200,000 cells/cm² per the physiology registry). Channel floor area = 400 µm × 20 mm = 0.08 cm². Seeding density × area gives the per-channel seed count.
caveats: Channel height was not specified; assumed 100 µm for geometry completeness, but culture area used is the channel floor (width × length = 0.08 cm²). If cells are seeded on side walls or a membrane, recompute the area.
PHH are human-derived primary material — BSL-2 containment is warranted.
PHH do not divide in vitro; seed at final density (no growth phase).
Confirm collagen I / Matrigel coating before seeding for attachment.
Seeding density range is 100,000–200,000 cells/cm²; 100,000 used here gives 8,000 cells/channel (200,000 would give 16,000).
